notes: Explore idea: rating changes (Elo, Glicko-2) as the last step of a club event in tournament-pairing-manager. Glicko-2 reproduces Glickman's worked example (1464.05/151.52/0.059996); Illinois step 5 vs bisection on 2,000 seeded players, rel gap <1e-5; Elo zero-sum check. Finding: PyPI glicko2 2.1.0 source uses mu^2 for phi^2 in step 5 (read, not run); re-implemented variant passes the paper's example at 4 dp and moves one period by <=0.0033 points over 20,000 players (eval/step5-variant.json). node --test 92/92; Playwright at 390 px clean. Next: cross-event ladder from the ratings CSV.
